title: Description: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned and a virtual server is configured with an APM Access profile and a SAML…
description: A vulnerability in BIG-IP APM occurs when a virtual server is configured with an APM Access profile and a SAML Service Provider agent with encrypted assertions enabled. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. This affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. The vulnerability allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to disrupt traffic by causing TMM restarts.
